Curated learning resources for GPU programming, MLIR, ML systems, inference optimization, and performance engineering. Each section is organized as its own learning track so compiler, kernel, and systems resources stay easy to scan.

CUDA / Triton / CuTe GPU Programming A structured path through GPU architecture, CUDA fundamentals, Triton, CUTLASS, CuTe DSL, GEMM, attention kernels, PTX, profiling, and modern ML systems performance work. CUDA Triton Performance Compilers / IR / Lowering MLIR A segmented MLIR path covering official docs, hands-on tutorials, blogs, videos, compiler-stack case studies, papers, and research/social posts. Dialects Lowering IREE
### Start Here
GPU Performance Engineering Resources A broad curriculum for learning GPU performance engineering from fundamentals toward frontier AI-lab kernel work Modern GPU Programming for ML Systems MLC course-style notes for writing modern GPU programs in the context of ML systems Basic Facts About GPUs A concise mental model for GPU architecture, execution, memory hierarchy, and practical performance constraints Modal GPU Glossary Quick reference for GPU terms, architecture vocabulary, serving concepts, and accelerator terminology
### CUDA Foundations
Nick CUDA Crash Course Fast practical introduction to CUDA programming and kernel structure Udacity Intro to Parallel Programming Classic foundations for parallel algorithms, CUDA kernels, scans, reductions, sorting, and GPU thinking NVIDIA Modern CUDA C++ Programming Class Official NVIDIA CUDA training material covering modern CUDA C++ programming patterns OLCF CUDA Training Series HPC-oriented CUDA lessons from Oak Ridge, useful for serious systems and performance practice Cornell Virtual Workshop: CUDA Concepts Readable CUDA concept notes for kernels, grids, blocks, memory, and execution hierarchy
### Triton, CuTe, CUTLASS, and DSLs
Triton GPU Kernels 101 Beginner-friendly Triton path with examples for writing custom ML kernels in Python Triton Kernels Playlist Common deep learning operators implemented as Triton kernels GPU Mode Lecture: CUTLASS CUTLASS concepts, abstractions, and how production GEMM kernels are structured Learning CUTLASS the Hard Way Deep dive into understanding CUTLASS by working through its abstractions and performance model Getting Started with CuTe DSL Practical entry point for NVIDIA CuTe DSL and layout-driven kernel programming CuTe Layouts Notes on CuTe layout algebra, a key idea behind modern CUTLASS and CuTe DSL kernels
### GEMM and Tensor Cores
How to Optimize a CUDA Matmul Kernel Canonical step-by-step CUDA SGEMM optimization path toward cuBLAS-like performance Inside NVIDIA GPUs: High-Performance Matmul Kernels Architecture, PTX/SASS, warp tiling, asynchronous pipelines, and tensor-core matmul intuition Modern GPU Matmul Optimization Register tiling, vectorized loads, shared-memory staging, cp.async, TMA, warp specialization, split-K, and tensor cores Advanced Matrix Multiplication Optimization CUDA SGEMM optimization with inline PTX, asynchronous memory copies, double buffering, and bank-conflict avoidance Tensor Cores for ML Systems Modern tensor-core programming concepts for ML workloads Matrix Multiplication on Blackwell: Breaking SOTA Blackwell matmul optimization case study with cluster launch control and state-of-the-art performance targets
### Attention and LLM Inference Kernels
FlashAttention from the Bottom Up Low-level explanation of FlashAttention and why memory movement dominates attention performance FlashAttention in Triton from First Principles Derives and implements FlashAttention with Triton, including the reasoning behind the algorithm CUTLASS and FlashAttention 3 GPU Mode lecture on CUTLASS and FlashAttention 3 implementation ideas How FlashAttention 4 Works Walkthrough of newer FlashAttention ideas and reverse-engineering attention performance PyTorch FlexAttention PyTorch-native attention flexibility and performance for custom attention masks and patterns Making Dr GRPO Go Brrr Fused decode-attention kernel work in an RL training loop, with practical microbenchmarking context
### PTX, SASS, and Hardware Internals
A Gentle Introduction to CUDA PTX CUDA compilation pipeline, PTX, SASS, and a hand-written PTX kernel playground Tensor Core Intrinsics: PTXAS Reverse Engineering Notes Reference notes for tensor-core intrinsics, PTXAS behavior, register allocation, and instruction scheduling Programming Hopper GPUs: Memory Consistency Model Hopper-era memory consistency and synchronization details for advanced kernel work NVFP4 Explained Blackwell low-precision floating point, microscaling, and hardware-algorithm co-design NVFP4 Blockscaled GEMM with CUTLASS CUTLASS tutorial for Blackwell-class NVFP4 blockscaled GEMM kernels
### Profiling and Performance Analysis
Introduction to Performance Analysis for NVIDIA GPUs Profiler-driven workflow for identifying common GPU performance bottlenecks NHR PerfLab Seminar Series Performance engineering talks across GPU programming, profiling, and HPC optimization CUTLASS GEMM Performance Measurement Guidelines Benchmarking methodology for GEMM kernels, measurement hygiene, and comparing against library baselines Kernel Fusion in CUDA How fusion reduces memory traffic and launch overhead, with practical CUDA optimization patterns
### Deep Dives and Reference Collections
The Feynman GPU Lectures A bottom-up GPU masterclass from transistors and CUDA cores to Tensor Cores, Hopper, and Blackwell Bob Crovella: NVIDIA Technical Blog Author archive with practical CUDA explanations, performance notes, and NVIDIA platform guidance The CUDA Handbook Book-style CUDA resource for building a durable understanding of GPU programming CUDA Notes Compact notes and examples for CUDA programming concepts
## MLIR ### Official Docs, Repos, and Reference Material
MLIR Related Publications Official MLIR publication index for the compiler framework, dialects, lowering, and research lineage IREE Retargetable MLIR-based machine learning compiler and runtime toolkit IREE MLIR Linalg Tutorial IREE learning material for MLIR Linalg and compiler lowering paths MLIR Sparsifier Google guide for sparse tensor compilation concepts and MLIR sparsifier workflows ONNX-MLIR Representation and reference lowering of ONNX models in MLIR compiler infrastructure ONNX-MLIR GitHub Source repository for ONNX model lowering, compiler passes, and runtime integration
### Tutorials and Hands-On Learning
MLIR: Getting Started Jeremy Kun's beginner-friendly entry into MLIR concepts, IR reading, and compiler toolchain setup MLIR for Beginners Tutorial Hands-on GitHub tutorial for building intuition around MLIR dialects, lowering, and passes Last Week Notes: MLIR Compact MLIR notes useful for quickly revisiting syntax, concepts, and compiler structure MLIR Optimization Passes Developer-oriented guide to writing and reasoning about MLIR optimization passes TVM and MLIR Learning Notes Learning repository for connecting TVM, MLIR, tensor compilers, and lowering ideas
### Blogs and Articles
MLIR: A Compiler Infrastructure for the End of Moore's Law Cornell CS6120 article explaining MLIR's motivation, dialect design, and role in heterogeneous computing What About the MLIR Compiler Infrastructure? Modular article on MLIR's role in AI compiler infrastructure and portable accelerator stacks Increasing Development Velocity of Giant AI Models Modular compiler-engineering case study on scaling large AI model development Increasing Development Velocity of Giant AI Models, Part 2 Follow-up on MLIR attribute design, model weights, and compiler infrastructure ergonomics Learn by Doing: TorchInductor Reduction Kernels Walkthrough of TorchInductor reduction kernel generation and compiler-produced GPU code FlyDSL: MLIR-Native GPU Kernel Development AMD ROCm article on a Python-first, MLIR-native DSL for expert GPU kernel development and tuning Accelerating Long-Context Model Training in JAX and XLA NVIDIA technical blog on compiler/runtime techniques for long-context training in JAX and XLA FTL Model Compiler Framework Nuro article on an ML compiler framework and production compiler design concerns
### Videos and Talks
MLIR Video Playlist Playlist of MLIR talks and tutorials for building compiler infrastructure intuition MLIR Beginner-Friendly Tutorial 2: Part 1 Alex Singer tutorial continuing MLIR motivation, IR reading, dialect lowering, and optimization workflows MLIR Beginner-Friendly Tutorial 2: Part 2 Follow-up Alex Singer tutorial with more beginner-friendly MLIR lowering and optimization detail Deep Dive into Cruise's ML Compiler NVIDIA GTC talk on building an extensible modular ML compiler using open-source compiler technologies ONNX and Python to C++ Graph Compilation Presentation on graph compilation for edge AI, ONNX, Python frontends, and C++ code generation
### Papers and Research
MLIR-Based Compiler Research Paper Compiler paper saved from the MLIR channel for deeper reading on MLIR-style compiler systems From Loop Nests to Silicon: MLIR-AIR Research on mapping AI workloads onto AMD NPUs with MLIR-AIR, explicit data movement, and spatial architectures Scorch Research PDF from the MLIR resource channel for compiler and accelerator systems reading Weight Block Sparsity Training, compilation, and AI engine accelerator resource focused on structured sparsity
### Other Posts and Case Studies
From JAX to VLIW: Tracing a TPU Compiler Stack Post tracing JAX through HLO, MLIR, and TPU compiler codegen down toward VLIW execution When XLA Is Not Enough: Pallas to VLIW Post on TPU compiler limits, algorithmic rewrites, Pallas, and low-level codegen realities A TPU from Scratch: JAX to VLIW Case study connecting custom RTL, JAX, HLO, MLIR, assembly, VLIW, binary codegen, and PJRT backend work MLIR Lowering Pipeline for Wafer-Scale Stencils Cerebras/EPCC post on MLIR lowering for stencil workloads on wafer-scale systems GPU Compiler from Scratch Post about a browser-executable GPU compiler pipeline from source code to MLIR IR, register allocation, and binary instructions Hexagon-MLIR Post on an AI compilation stack for Qualcomm neural processors and MLIR-based lowering PolyBlocks Compiler Infrastructure Post on reusable compiler infrastructure for AI chips and PyTorch/JAX compilers for new accelerators
